I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in the DM. Nothing has been sent; the draft is in drafts until someone reviews and sends it.

The subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". The mail gives $2,101 per seat, says Marcus Lindqvist provided the figure and that Anselm approved sharing it. It also asks Hollis to keep it within the deal team.

Hollis is internal, so the draft didn't need Ruth's approval. The per-seat rate is a finance figure, and Anselm's approval as CFO covers sending it to him.

The gbrain knowledge base refused my search because its connection isn't linked to any member, so I couldn't look up the rate myself. The $2,101 figure comes only from Anselm's message. To fix the connection, an admin on the brain host would run:

gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member '<MEMBER>'
